display.label: Value field to match
display.description: The value field to test, addressed with dot notation. A bare name targets a top-level field; a dotted name such as 'after.status' descends into nested structs.

display.label: Match pattern
display.description: A Java regular expression tested against the field's string value.

display.label: Pattern match mode
display.description: How the pattern is applied: 'full' requires the whole value to match, 'partial' matches when the pattern is found anywhere in the value. Default: full

display.label: Behavior when the value cannot be evaluated
display.description: What to do when the pattern cannot be evaluated against the field (value not a struct, path absent, intermediate not a struct, field null, or field not a textual scalar): 'ignore' treats the record as not matching, 'fail' halts the stream. Default: ignore
